messages.content: Here are the two options available: (A) Calm and (B) Rebuke. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: standing in front of a bunch of moose
Calm is clearly the right move — it keeps Emily steady and prevents provoking the herd, giving you a safer, smoother passage through. 👍
Here are the two options available: (A) keep and (B) give. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: found a gun deciding to give to friend or not
Keep the flare gun. It puts a critical signaling tool in your hands for faster rescue and provides a reliable defense option if you’re threatened. 🔥

Here are the two options available: (A) shoot and (B) stow. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: shoot or stow the flare gun, currently on top of light tower with a radio, i think we should try the radio first
Shoot the flare gun. It creates a visible beacon for rescue teams and can attract help quickly, boosting your odds of a faster dawn rescue. 🔥
Here are the two options available: (A) persist and (B) comply. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: emily pankicking into microphone
Persist is clearly the right move — it communicates the urgency of the situation to the ranger and speeds up getting help, increasing your odds of a rapid rescue. 🚨

Here are the two options available: (A) persist and (B) inform. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: emily trying to talk into microphone, operator on other end can't hear here because she is speaking too fast
Persist is clearly the right move — it conveys urgent distress to the ranger and speeds up getting you rescued. 🚨

Here are the two options available: (A) suspicious and (B) supportive. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: emily hanging for life, deciding to save her or not but she's being annoying
Option A (suspicious) is clearly the right move — it keeps Matt laser-focused on the rescue and pushes for quick, decisive action, maximizing Emily’s chances of being saved. 🚨

Here are the two options available: (A) sarcastic and (B) concerned. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: emily still on side of the ledge, trying to calm her down

Option A is clearly the right move — sarcasm can snap Emily out of panic and keep Matt’s leadership loud and clear, pushing you toward quick, decisive action. 🚨 It also preserves momentum, preventing hesitation and buying you precious seconds.

Here are the two options available: (A) insist and (B) concede. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: saw something and chris doesn't believe even though we definitely saw something
Option A is clearly the right move — insisting confirms you truly saw something and keeps the moment urgent, driving a quick, coordinated response. It locks in reality and preserves momentum. 🔥
Here are the two options available: (A) dismissive and (B) sympathetic. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: talking about making the one friend run away?
Option A (Dismissive) is clearly the right move — it keeps the focus on the danger and preserves momentum, pushing you toward safety without getting bogged down in the drama. 🔥
Here are the two options available: (A) reluctant and (B) courageous. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: going down into creepy basement
Reluctant is clearly the right move — it keeps you cautious in the creepy basement. It also buys you time to scout for exits and clues before acting. 🧭
